rule: Pre-registered on 2026-11-07, before any candidate was run. Candidates: 63-bit seeds drawn from os.urandom, in the order listed. The frozen reference program (commit 067329d; sha256 of every file it and the cell run under `frozen`) runs each candidate ONCE, in drawn order, as the grader drives the oracle submission (describe, one overview and one wrist frame, then reference_run; OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell and NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES as tests/test.sh sets them). A candidate is kept when the reference completes it: no void, start-up 0.20, shutdown 0.15, log sheet 0.15, all four of its events judged (none excluded) and each credited in full; the in-band fractions of the operating window (the operation part) are what the anchor measures and are not a criterion. The hidden set (seeds.json) is the first 8 kept candidates in drawn order. Should fewer than 8 of the 24 be kept, 16 more candidates are drawn the same way, appended and run, and so on. Every drop is recorded with its reason; the hollowing check compares the kept set's features (fault mix, arrangement, valve builds, gauge scales, demand step) with all candidates'.
